Robin Padilla on Saturday, Sept. 19, said that his decision to not run for public office in the 2028 national elections is final, further saying he plans to move to an Islamic country with his family. “Ay, final na po ‘yon. Oo, napag desisyunan na po namin ‘yan ng asawa ko. Tutuloy na lang po namin ‘yung aming plano na mag— sa isang Islamic country para mapalaki namin ‘yung anak namin sa Islamikong paraan,” he said during an interview at DWIZ program.
